hero.subtitel: Live musicians who fill the dance floor at your wedding, corporate event or private party. Fully taken care of, tailored to you.

over.tekst: Relovation is a flexible live music concept for stylish events. No fixed formula, but music that moves with the moment, tuned to your audience, venue and programme. We take care of the whole musical side and think along with you.

gelegenheden.tekst: From ceremony and welcome drink to the start of the evening. We carry the musical thread through your wedding day, tuned to every moment.
Stylish live music for receptions, networking moments and company parties. Music that puts your guests at ease and sets the right tone.
Warm live music that carries conversation without drowning it out. For openings, receptions and evenings where atmosphere comes first.
